title: continue: skip just this pass
idea: Introduce continue: it skips the REST of the current pass and jumps to the next one. Show predictable output.

exercises.explanation: On i == 3, continue skips the print and moves on. So it prints 1, 2, 4, 5 - skipping 3.
It skips the rest of the current pass and goes straight to the next pass of the loop.
options: It skips to the next pass

exercises.prompt: Unlike break, continue does NOT end the loop - it only skips the remainder of the current pass.
exercises.explanation: True - the loop keeps going; continue just abandons the current pass early.
continue skips the print on the i == 3 pass and moves to the next value.
Even numbers 2,4,6 trigger continue and are skipped; the odds 1, 3, 5 print.

exercises.prompt: After continue skips a pass, does the loop variable still advance to the next value?
exercises.explanation: Yes - continue just ends the current pass; the loop moves on to the next value as usual.
options: Yes - the next pass starts normally

exercises.prompt: Arrange a loop that prints 1..5 but skips 4.
exercises.explanation: Loop 1..5, if i == 4 continue, else print i. The continue skips only the i == 4 pass.
Multiples of 3 (3,6,9) are skipped; 10 numbers minus 3 skipped = 7 printed.

exercises.prompt: continue is a clean way to express 'skip the ones that ...' without deeply nested ifs.
exercises.explanation: True - continue skips the unwanted passes up front, keeping the rest of the body simple.

exercises.prompt: In one line, what does continue do?
exercises.explanation: Skips the rest of the current pass and goes to the next one - the loop carries on.
options: Skip the rest of this pass; go to the next
